This is where the fun begins!|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ferroda]] to [[X2]], during the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|battle]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]|<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>}}
The '''Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter''', also known as the '''ARC-170 starfighter''' and '''Advanced Recon fighter''',<ref name="Millennium Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> was a heavy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that saw widespread use by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

Designed and manufactured by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]], the ARC-170 was an ancestor of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], which would be mainly used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|We can lose the V-wings, but those ARCs have Class One-point-five hyperdrives. They'll follow us to Hell and back.|[[Reeze Duurmun]], escaping [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with [[Tobb Jadak]] following the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]|<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />}}
===Design===
[[File:ARC170_ICS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|ARC-170 cross-section.]]

The ARC-170 was jointly produced by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] and [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporation]]. Like their other starfighter designs of its time, such as the lighter [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95]], and the heavier [[PTB-625 planetary bomber/Legends|PTB-625]], and [[NTB-630 naval bomber/Legends|NTB-630]], the ARC-170 had a narrow spaceframe flanked by large engines. The ARC-170 also possessed an [[S-foils/Legends|S-foil system]], which helped to radiate heat, something that aided the fighter's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]]. This also provided additional stability during atmospheric flight.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

Using its front deflector shield projectors to disperse heat generated from air resistance, the ARC-170 could reach hypersonic speeds in atmospheric flight .<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

The ARC-170 was a departure from other starfighter designs of the Clone Wars era. Fighters such as the [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus'']] and the [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis'']] were built to be small, fast, and maneuverable, at the cost of heavy weapons, shields, and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]]. On the other hand, the ARC-170 was large, rugged, and capable of long independent operations.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

===Military role===
[[File:Arc170_pair.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A pair of ARC-170s [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|over]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].]]
The ARC-170 were typically deployed from [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], and were often sent on dangerous scout missions and raids deep in enemy territory.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /> To allow the ARC-170 to perform these missions, the fighter was equipped with a Class 1.5 hyperdrive, and its nose was filled with powerful sensors, scanners, and jammers.<ref name="CCS" />

The ARC-170 carried enough consumables for five days of operation. However, the supplies and additional equipment had a price and the ARC-170 was quite slow. Durable armor and shielding, as well as two tail guns, helped the ARC-170 to survive when surrounded by swarms of smaller, faster enemy fighters, although it remained vulnerable to enemy anti-fighter guns.<ref name="CCS" />

===Weaponry===
[[File:ARC170starfighter.jpg|thumb|left|250px|ARC-170 starfighter was heavy armed]]
The ARC-170 possessed powerful weaponry. It carried six [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]], and its wingtip-mounted medium [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] were unusually large for a starfighter.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /> ARC-170s were often used as the heavy-hitters in strike forces, escorted by V-wings and Eta-2s. ARC-170's could carry [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] for anti-fighter work.<ref name="SotJ" />

The ARC-170 was manned by a crew of three clone operators: a pilot, a forward gunner who operated the wingtip-mounted lasers, and a tail gunner who operated the rear-mounted cannons. The fighter also carried an astromech droid to perform onboard repairs and navigation. It was also possible for the pilot to operate the wingtip laser cannons if a co-pilot wasn't available.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

===Customization===
During the Clone Wars, it was common for elite pilots to customize their vessels with elaborate designs, such as the elite [[Razor Squadron/Legends|Razor Squadron]].<ref name="Titanium">''[[Hasbro]] Star Wars TITANIUM SERIES Die Cast ARC-170 Vehicle #18592 - Product Detail''</ref>

The ARC-170 that shot down [[Plo Koon's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Plo Koon's Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was kitted out to display information on its cockpit display screen using an [[Unidentified script (Star Wars '76)|unidentified script]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|For months, every hour of our downtime was spent in the simulator, preparing for the time we would face our enemies from the cockpit of a 170. Finally the day came to earn our wings.|Unnamed [[501st Legion/Legends|501st]] stormtrooper|<ref name="BII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
[[File:MalastareEPbombrun.png|thumb|left|250px|ARC-170s attacking [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] forces on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]]]
Originally introduced and adopted by the Republic shortly before the Clone Wars,<ref name="Warfare" /> ARCs were used fairly extensively during the late Clone Wars.<ref name="TCW:TZB">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref> The skilled clone pilot [[Jai'galaar (clone)|Jai'galaar]] was selected as one of the first test pilots for the ARC-170 by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], granting Jag a chance at redemption after his failings during the [[Retreat at Katraasii]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>

During the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], a squadron of ARC fighters escorted a squadron of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wings]] carrying the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]] and provided cover against [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]] by strafing enemy ground formations.<ref name="TCW:TZB" /> They were also used in the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Defense of Kamino]]<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref> and later in a [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|rescue mission]] to [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]].<ref name="Citadel Rescue">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref> Shortly before the Battle of Coruscant, a squadron of ARCs provided cover for [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on [[Tythe/Legends|Tythe]], but were mostly destroyed.<ref name="LOE" />

[[File:SiegeOfCoruscantScenarioPack-SWZ.png|thumb|right|200px|ARC-170s during the Battle of Coruscant.]]
During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[Clone Flight Squad Seven/Legends|Clone Flight Squad Seven]] (operating with ARC-170s) covered for Kenobi and Skywalker as they made their way to the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. Although Squad Seven suffered many casualties, they allowed the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to successfully board the ship and rescue [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Large numbers of ARC-170s were destroyed by [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]] in the battle.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Galactic Empire===
[[File:ARC-170.jpg|thumb|left|180px|An Imperial ARC-170 fighter with S-foils retracted.]]

Later, after Palpatine issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], ARC-170s flying over the skies of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] under the command of [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] Jag turned on Jedi Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. The ARC-170 squadron fired upon his [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 starfighter]], destroying the fighter's engines. Plo Koon could not regain control of his ship and plunged to his death as he and what remained of the forward part of the fighter crashed into a building on one of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia's]] [[Bridge city/Legends|bridge-cities]].<ref name="ROTS" />

A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the ARC-170s of [[Green Squadron (Galactic Empire)|Green Squadron]] were deployed from a [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. They took part in the second portion of the [[Shrouded Offensive]] at [[Ostor]]. They strafed the city shield, but were ambushed by followers of the rogue clone trooper [[Kaddak (clone trooper)|Kaddak]] in [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]]. The attackers were fought off, but quickly disappeared. Vader led the squadron back to cover the Star Destroyer. After Commander [[Hock Malsuum]] disabled the shield, the ARC-170s attacked the city, leaving it in ruins.<ref name="Cry">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows]]''</ref>

[[File:AllianceOverhaul-SWX.png|thumb|right|220px|An ARC-170 starfighter receiving an overhaul by the Rebel Alliance]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], ARC-170s could be found in both Imperial and Rebel fleets, where they were considered elite craft.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> As with all craft commissioned by the new Empire, ARC-170s were henceforth given the standard 'Imperial gray' color scheme, doing away with the variety of colorful markings that military vessels bore to identify their squadron affiliations with during the Clone Wars. Incom would go on to produce the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], the successor to the ARC-170.<ref name="CCS" />

One old ARC-170 was found in an [[Rebel hangar|old secret hangar]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] [[Imarrra]] and [[Orrekazzapirr]] took this ARC-170 after they had been freed from the [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|Imperial prison facility]] and managed to punch a hole through the Imperial blockade around the planet.<ref name="ROTW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

[[Kylantha|Queen Kylantha]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] also owned several old ARC-170s. Her personal ship technicians had rehauled a few of them and turned them into formidable fighters again. She gave one to an adventurer as a token of appreciation for helping the Wookiees Imarrra and Orrekazzapirr escape from captivity.<ref name="ROTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ARC-170 was named after "ART-170," the title of the artwork form by concept artist [[Ryan Church]] that inspired the finalized design. Originally, it was referred to simply as a "clone fighter" in the script for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']].

[[File:ARC170_concept.jpg|thumb|left|200px|ARC-170 concept art.]]

The [[Wikipedia: Head-up display|HUD]] seen on [[Davijaan/Legends|Odd Ball's]] ARC-170 cockpit during the Battle of Coruscant has the same targeting display as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] X-wing in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ROTS" />

The joint development of the ARC-170 by Incom and Subpro Corporations seems to contradict a HoloNet News report that claims the companies severed their partnership shortly before the onset of the Clone Wars.<ref name="hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|issue=46|url=business/1337_2.html|text=Incom / Subpro Development Deal Cancelled}}</ref> This issue may possibly be [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] by the fact that most of the design for the ship took place before the split. Even so, it was released as an Incom/Subpro design, and it is extremely unusual for design credit to continue to be shared between companies who have broken off relations.

In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', the ARC-170 fighter is considered a medium starfighter, and equivalent to a T-65 X-wing starfighter. The game also only allows one individual to board it, rather than three to fill all the positions.<ref name="BII" />

In the ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was said to have a projectile cannon above their wing mounted laser cannons.

In 2005, [[the LEGO Group]] released an ARC-170 set, which included three clone pilots (which oddly had V-wing pilot uniforms; this was due to technical limitations, however) and [[R4-D5]]. A strange thing about this set is that it had only one rear laser cannon. LEGO released another ARC-170 in 2010, which is more accurate in depicting the fighter (and pilots) and includes one standard clone pilot, Captain Jag, [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[R4-P44/Legends|R4-P44]]. An Episode 3 Collectors Set (set 65771) was released in 2005. In the set was an ARC-170, a droid Tri-Fighter, a buzz droid, three clone pilots, R4-D5, an Episode 3 LEGO poster and a CD-ROM "From the LEGO Vaults."

In the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|Clone Wars]] episode ''[[The Zillo Beast]]'', the ARC-170 squadron escorting the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] that drop the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]] during the course of the episode have the same engine noise as the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] in the original trilogy. This is probably implemented to highlight that the ARC-170 is the precursor to the X-wing.

In 2009, an Imperial variant of the ship was first depicted visually as a toy for [[Hasbro]]'s ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' toy range.<ref name="Shadow ARC-170 Toy">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=ARC-170 Fighter|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWvehARC170Shadow.asp}}</ref>
